name: Write a file, approve it, open a pull request
description: A writer agent commits a file on agent/<run>/writer; the run pauses at a gate, and on approval a tool node pushes the writer's branch and opens a pull request.

steps.instructions: Read the README, then add a short NOTES.md that summarises what this repository is for, and commit it.

steps.title: Open a pull request with the notes?
steps.prompt: Approving pushes the writer's branch to GitHub and opens a pull request.

args.title: Add NOTES.md
args.body: A summary of what this repository is for, written by an agent and approved at a gate.
